decisions.evidence: The title omitted the specified group-like element required by the Definition. Chin §2.4, printed pp.5–6, defines (g,h)-skew primitives; the local Definition specializes to (g,g), explicitly excludes an implicit unit, and retains counit-one/zero normalization. Qualified the title only; the Definition, dependencies and consumer interfaces are unchanged. Also corrected the Chin locator to printed pp.5–6 so it includes both definitions.

The title omitted the g-relative qualification present in the Example. Qualified the title, preserving the Example and proof. Independently checked the three steps: basis-wise coalgebra laws hold; b^2=0 forces b=0 in a field and epsilon forces a=1; relative primitives have a=0, and every bx satisfies both required equations. This includes characteristic 2 and b=0, without an algebra unit or AC. Direct tensor-basis/free-map/field suppliers and Stufler Examples 3.2(1),(4), Chin §2.4 agree with the exact relative condition. Also corrected the Chin locator to printed pp.5–6 so it includes both definitions.

Confirmed the missing coassociativity qualification in Proof 2.1, not a failure of counit uniqueness. In the refuter algebra, (aa)a=a whereas a(aa)=0; on its finite dual, with a-dual functional f, the two triple coproducts evaluated at (a,a,a) are 1 and 0, while evaluation at the unit is a counit. The repair makes triple equality conditional on coassociativity and keeps uniqueness for arbitrary linear Delta. Reviewed all direct suppliers and Stufler Definition 3.3 / UCSD §1.4. Statement and logical dependencies are unchanged; no consumer premise is narrowed.
